title: Expose 112 funded native helper queries in an entrance prologue
body:
This forward interface exposes **112 common rank-one Gaussian queries before the original native operations begin**, using 112 H1 children already paid by the center-free producer. An invertible 358-owner helper basis supplies independent query arguments. The prologue holds each actual child output; at its original cut, a whole-field swap restores exactly the source state. All 632 original input directions and the coded main endpoint are retained.

The query rescheduling adds no Gaussian call or scalar pass. Return completion still costs **26 H5 + six H1**: 358 cold helpers return as H9 jobs; 50 hot-helper jobs keep their original targets. The observations receive no productive credit. The early version explicitly charges 224 owned fields, 224 copies, 448 clears and 112 whole-field swaps, plus the existing basis/monomial work. Literal phase recipes, chronological restrictions and the all-width argument are included.

This is a helper-input query interface, **not a complete Gaussian caller or a new exponent**. Main-input embedding with restoration of displaced helpers, every orientation actually used by a caller, and the complete precision/storage/outer budget remain open. The broader investigation continues in [Discussion #4930](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/4930#discussioncomment-19154637).

Validation at `568717635d8d11175a80024c9c596e16f54b1ea4`:

- Registered Python 3.12.15 normal and `-O` replays pass: all 632 native endpoint rows, 358 scalar basis inputs, 112 signed-tableau plus absolute-phase response identities and 32 completion identities.
- The hoisted schedule checks 632 original plus 225 arbitrary owned inputs, all 112 replacement cuts, unchanged paid inventory and terminal owned cleanup.
- Six controls reject input contamination, singular basis, wrong absolute phase, missing completion, wrong held query argument and a swap without chart transport.
- Committed-byte/source-history preflight passes for 17 files. Export integrity and an optimized direct replay in a fresh exported directory also pass. Hosted planning and the registered replay also pass on this exact updated head.

Submission refresh: canonical main `1ec1119972c9aefe42525172d07b332fcff81cb4`, 21:54 UTC on 2026-10-23, priority 7, selected conditional κ=.0030217758. Live overlap was refreshed before initial submission and newer observer-limit/owned-relation scopes were read before this update. Scientific inputs retain the explicit earlier freeze and manifest baseline; those bytes are unchanged on current main.
